title: Elementary positivity of chromatic quasisymmetric functions
summary: We prove that the chromatic quasisymmetric function of every natural unit interval graph is elementary-positive over $`\mathbb N[q]`$. This resolves the elementary-positivity part of the Shareshian–Wachs conjecture.

review.reason: Proves elementary positivity of chromatic quasisymmetric functions of natural unit interval graphs.
